projection.title: Net worth projection
projection.subtitle: How your wealth may grow from what you own today, the returns you choose and your monthly contributions. It is a model, not a forecast.

table.title: Asset classes

table.loansNote: Liabilities fall with the loan repayment schedule

dialog.title: Projection parameters
dialog.description: Annual growth and monthly contribution for each asset class. A switched-off class stays at today's value.
dialog.hint: Contributions are added every month. Loans follow their own schedule and have no parameters.
dialog.blankHint: A blank growth keeps the default: for bank accounts and bonds the weighted rate of your own accounts and bonds.

empty.title: Nothing to project yet
empty.description: The projection shows how your net worth could grow over the coming years, based on what you hold today plus the growth rates and monthly contributions you assume. Add an account or an investment to get started.

settings.title: Projection Parameters
settings.editDescription: Configure growth rates and monthly contributions for each asset class
settings.growthRatesHint: Leave bank accounts or bonds empty to use the rate calculated from your own accounts and bonds (shown in grey).

manage.title: Manage tags
manage.description: Tags belong to groups, which split the portfolio in the charts.
manage.noTagsInGroup: No tag in this group yet
manage.moveConflict: The tag cannot move to {{group}}: {{positions}} already have another tag there.
manage.deleteTagDescription: The tag disappears from every position. Positions stay unchanged.
manage.deleteGroupDescription: Tags in the group stay, just without a group.

assign.title: Assign tags
assign.description: Pick the positions and the tags you want to give them.
assign.hintSingle: A position has at most one tag in each group. The chosen tag replaces the current one.
assign.hintMany: A position has at most one tag in each group. The chosen tag replaces the current one; groups left on No change stay as they are. Tags without a group are added.

stocksAnalysis.tagManagementDescription: Create tags and assign them to your stock holdings
stocksAnalysis.createTagDescription: Create a new tag to categorize your investments

stocksAnalysis.twrDescription: Time-weighted return removes distortion caused by buy/sell transactions
stocksAnalysis.metricsChartDescription: Each tag’s share of your portfolio value. A holding can carry several tags, so the shares may add up to more than 100%.

scope.title: Which positions to analyse
scope.hint: Click a tag to keep only the positions that carry it. Tags from two groups must both be on a position.

scope.ungroupedTitle: Tags without a group can overlap
